object.script:
grace = 15 max = 12 min = 6 gear = 1 function onTick() if grace > 0 then grace = grace - 1 end
rps = input.getNumber(1) manual = input.getBool(1) gearUp = input.getBool(2) gearDown = input.getBool(3)
if manual and grace == 0 then if gearUp and gear < input.getNumber(2) then gear = gear + 1 grace = 15 end if (gearDown or rps < 3) and gear > 1 then gear = gear - 1 grace = 15 end else if grace == 0 then if rps > 12 and gear < input.getNumber(2) then gear = gear + 1 grace = 15 end if rps < 6 and gear > 1 then gear = gear - 1 grace = 15 end end end
output.setNumber(1, gear) end
